svg.text: PLACEHOLDER · characters: aria, bram, sylfie · seed: None

text.tspan: Aria casting fireball spell — instead of flames, a joyful
explosion of pink flower petals and strawberry-scented sparkles
engulfs a practice dummy. Aria looks delighted-surprised, tongue
out. Bram writing notes furiously. Sylfie watching with curious
head tilt, sparkles at her fingertips. Characters: ARIA: human
girl 7-8, small stocky build, warm beige skin with nose
freckles, messy chin-length chestnut bob (#5d4037) with single
lavender streak (#c7b8ea), large bright amber-gold eyes
sleeves, mint-green satchel (#a8e6cf), scuffed brown boots
ink-smudged fingers, singed robe hem, tiny star scar on chin,
determined concentrated expression with tongue peeking out |
BRAM: human boy 8, tall lanky build, pale olive skin, floppy
